description:
FILED s453 (Fable box-elision review, faster-codegen-suggestions.md par.13 gap 2).  Write families are OPERAND-derived, so `$s = $s + $_` is an unproven write-shape (PCL_B_DEBUG: reasons=[write-shape] uses={num,opaque}) though p-+ yields num by the OPERATOR regardless of operands.  Probed: `$s = $s + $i` raw, `$s = $s + $_` boxed, `$s += $_` raw -- same value, three verdicts.  FIX: derive the write family from the operators RESULT type for the closed arith/string op set (+ - * / % ** <=> etc -> num; . x -> str); overload is not a hazard for the A-verdict path here beyond what the existing gates cover, and the B-freeze is already off file-wide under overload (probed s453: _overload_in_file gates ONLY the freeze).  CLOSES the intloop= bench row gap by itself (4.86x -> the 2.07x class; the remaining 2.07x is #761s topic loop).  Also revisit the write-incdec-root gate: with operator-derived families more roots qualify.  Bar: corpus-diff + sweep + bench-exec re-run.

DONE s456af.  Kind-A gate `raw-op-family`.  _tw_shape_ok no longer walks the operands under an %ARITH_OP root (nor under the prefix_op -/+/! arm): the OPERATOR decides the family.  That is the file header's own stated invariant; _tw_operand_ok contradicted it by rejecting PPI::Token::Magic and unknown-sub calls.  The operand walk STAYS for the no-operator case, which is the real hazard it was written for (a bare `$y` RHS stores $y's BOX -> the slot aliases).  NOT a new overload class: a plain $scalar operand was already accepted and may hold an overloaded object, so `$a + f()` is exactly as exposed as `$a + $b` was -- probed with two overload classes, the handler's object survives in the raw slot and ref($s) is still V.  The str/num split is untouched so the magical-string-increment guard (write-incdec-root) still fires.  BENCH: intloop= 4.83x -> 3.01x (the rest was #761).  20 probes vs perl identical.  Guard rows 7-12.
